name: Medium
how_to_post: Create a free account and choose Write.
Add the title, readable sections, your own examples and accurate author details.
Choose a public story, review topic tags and publish only after the author approves it.
link_guidance: Use a contextual reference where useful. Check the live link attributes; Medium distribution is separate from external indexing.
eligibility: Human authorship and original insight matter. Pure promotion and AI-generated material face distribution restrictions; review its current AI policy.
fit_note: A useful explanatory article for readers exploring the topic.

name: Substack
how_to_post: Create a publication with an accurate author identity.
Write a post and choose free/public access.
Preview web and email versions; publish or schedule after approval.
link_guidance: Link to the source guide where it supports the issue. Keep the web version publicly accessible.
eligibility: Free publishing is separate from paid subscriptions. Only send email to legitimately subscribed readers.
fit_note: Best when the business can maintain a useful recurring series.
article_angle: A practical field note on {topic} for {audience}

name: DEV Community
how_to_post: Create an author account or join the real organization.
Open the editor and write a reproducible technical article with relevant tags.
If syndicating your own published article, set its canonical URL; preview and publish.
link_guidance: Use a relevant documentation, code or tutorial link. A canonical tag is not a promise that one version will rank.
eligibility: Choose a developer topic with substance; review current community and AI disclosure rules before posting.
fit_note: Developer readers need implementation details, examples and limitations.

name: Blogger
how_to_post: Sign in, create one clearly identified blog and choose its address.
Create a post with original useful content and preview it.
Set public visibility and publish or schedule after approval.
link_guidance: A contextual source link can be added in the editor. Check the published HTML and visibility.
eligibility: Use as a maintained publication, not a network of disposable blogs. A blog you control is owned media.
fit_note: An optional owned publication when the business can maintain it.

name: Reddit
how_to_post: Identify a relevant community and read its current rules and promotion threads.
Participate with a useful standalone explanation; disclose your relationship to the business.
Only include a link where that specific community permits it, then respond to discussion.
link_guidance: Select the exact community/thread first. Some communities ban promotion entirely; a post without a permitted link is not a backlink.
eligibility: Check topic fit, account requirements and moderator rules. There is no universal posting ratio or guaranteed acceptance.
fit_note: Audience research and useful discussion where participation is welcome.

name: Teletype
how_to_post: Create an account and an accurately named blog.
Write a public post with headings, useful examples and supporting links.
Preview and publish after review; recheck current free publishing terms.
link_guidance: Use a relevant original-resource link and inspect the published post rather than assuming dofollow.
eligibility: Official feature guidance describes free publishing; that guidance is older and monetization extras have separate terms.
fit_note: A supplementary long-form explanation if the audience uses the platform.

name: HubPages
link_guidance: Link placement and rel attributes have not been checked.
eligibility: Staff announcement: new publishing and editing were disabled during the 2026 wind-down.

name: Hashnode
how_to_post: Create an account and a blog on the free subdomain.
Write a technical post with headings, examples and suitable tags.
Set the original-source canonical when applicable, preview and publish.
link_guidance: Point to the relevant original documentation or guide, not an unrelated sales page.
eligibility: Use a real technical subject and check current plan limits or paid extras.
fit_note: Suitable for practical technical learning and developer-facing services.
article_angle: Building and evaluating {topic}: a practical walkthrough

name: ArticleTed
how_to_post: Review the current guidelines and a relevant category, then register.
Write your own useful article; keep URLs out of the title and short description.
Preview the allowed in-article links and submit after final review.
link_guidance: Guidelines allow three links in the article and require at least 800 characters; check current rules before writing.
eligibility: Free publishing is advertised, but overly promotional material is excluded from the free route. No duplicate or rebranded articles.
fit_note: An optional educational directory submission; evaluate recent category quality before investing.

eligibility: Use an authentic member or an authorized Page administrator. An owned Page does not equal independent endorsement.

name: Quora
how_to_post: Find a real question the business can answer from experience.
Write a complete helpful answer directly on the page.
Disclose affiliation and add a source link only when it is part of the helpful answer.
link_guidance: No link dumping: self-promotion must form part of a direct helpful response. A question URL must be selected before execution.
eligibility: Community answers are not article submissions. Avoid invented questions, repetitive answers or paid promotion in a free plan.
fit_note: A question-led explanation for people already seeking an answer.
article_angle: Answer a genuine question about choosing {topic}
